intro: Falaath Village is a gathering place for penitent shen'dorei seeking to win back the favor of the Windlord, Al'Akir. Marked recruits journey from Shen'dar Village to report to Missionary Jasaan and join their fellow faithful.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It gladdens my heart that you wish to serve Al'Akir. Our current trials as a people stem from our own complacency. We grew prideful and took the bounty of the winds for granted. The stagnation that followed is the reason the spirits of the wind abandoned us.

Only through acts of contrition may we feel the wind's caress once more. If you seek the fellowship of like-minded shen'dorei, go to Falaath Village and find Missionary Jasaan there. I will mark you so that the faithful will know you as a recruit.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What is this? A new acolyte seeking to serve the windlord sent by sister Sania? Truly we are blessed by the touch of the four winds this day!
We welcome all who seek to bask in the blessings of Al'Akir.
